Jared —

Following Camila’s note: we put together two concrete structures. High level: both options give Atlas predictable blended per-token economics, but they differ on commitment sizing and the true-up cap.

Option A — Growth-aligned (recommended if you expect >40% YoY growth):
- Commit: 150M tokens/month (annualized commit = 1.8B tokens)
- Blended per-token rate: $0.00082
- Annual true-up: +/- 25% (caps either direction) with net true-up billed/credited at the blended rate
- Renewal uplift limit: 15% year-over-year (protects against large price jumps)

Option B — Conservative (recommended if growth uncertain):
- Commit: 120M tokens/month (annualized = 1.44B tokens)
- Blended per-token rate: $0.00088
- Annual true-up: +/- 40%
- Renewal uplift limit: 8%

Both include: 30-day notice for model-tier switches, basket of fallback models for capacity constraints, and an optional monthly overage threshold with a discounted overage rate (applies after 120% of committed volume). I attached the tier schedule workbook with line-item math.

Attachment: Redwood_Tier_Schedule_v3.xlsx (xlsx, 48 KB)

Happy to jump on a call to walk through the numbers.

Thanks,

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Jared — quick clarifications from finance: 

1) Credits/true-ups: annual true-ups are settled as a single line-item at the time of the annual reconciliation (renewal date). If credit owed to you, we will either apply it to the next invoice cycle within 30 days or, upon request, issue a one-time credit note. Overage charges (if you exceed the true-up cap) are billed monthly once the overage threshold is hit; we can set a grace buffer for one month per year if needed.

2) Mid-term moves between Option A and B: we do allow mid-term re-tiering via an amendment. The amendment proration uses the blended rate difference and is applied pro-rata from amendment effective date. To limit churn we require: (a) minimum 60 days’ notice, (b) a single mid-term adjustment per 12-month period, and (c) a cap on cumulative upward adjustments of 20% of the original commit for the contract year.

Let me know if you want wording I can drop into the addendum.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Renewals Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
